<!--
Before filing, please check that the idea fits AmnesiaLight's privacy-first,
no-telemetry, lightweight philosophy. Anything that phones home or adds weight
is unlikely to be accepted.
-->

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation, not just the
solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like AmnesiaLight to do.

## Which area does this affect?

- [ ] Hardened preferences (`profile/user.js`)
- [ ] Organisation policy (`distribution/policies.json`)
- [ ] Theme (`profile/chrome/`)
- [ ] Launchers / wipe scripts (`launch/`)
- [ ] Search (`profile/search/`)
- [ ] Assets / docs / tooling
- [ ] Other

## Privacy impact

Does this change what is sent over the network, what persists to disk, or what
permissions are granted? If yes, explain how it stays private-by-default.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Mockups, references, or examples. Do not include third-party brand names.
